# Inventory Requirements Checklist: Repository Inventory

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, completeness, and traceability of the SPEC-0002 requirements for the repository inventory documentation deliverable.
**Created**: 2026-08-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all eight required inventory categories (Repository, Technology, Dependency Graph, Project Structure, Legacy, External Dependencies, COM Dependencies, Configuration) explicitly specified as deliverables? [Completeness, Spec §9 FR-001..FR-008]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the scope boundary (entire repository vs legacy-only) explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §5]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the out-of-scope items explicitly enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §6]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the deliverable location for the inventory documents specified? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the requirement to record repository-vs-findings discrepancies documented? [Completeness, Spec §10 BR-002]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the requirement that the inventory is documentation-only (no implementation) explicitly stated? [Completeness, Spec §6, §10 BR-003]
